children: STRATS SM Trust for Wal-Mart Stores Securities distributed $53,014.26 in interest to certificateholders on October 15, 2026.
The trust received $53,014.26 from the swap counterparty and distributed the amount as interest.
Each $25 certificate received $0.09700333 in interest; no principal or premium was distributed.
No aggregate interest was due and unpaid as of the distribution date, and no fees were paid from underlying securities proceeds.
The trust held $13.663 million of underlying notes, with 546,520 certificates and $13.663 million in aggregate certificate principal balance outstanding.
